Cell-mirror supervisor — keeps the hatch cell -> yote live mirror healthy. Runs every 5 minutes. All work happens on the hatch cell via the exec tool.

Steps, in order:

1. DAEMON CHECK: read /home/hatch/workspace/.tmpdir/cell-mirror.pid. Verify liveness with `kill -0 <pid>` AND confirm identity with `ps -p <pid> -o args=` (must contain `cell-mirror-daemon`). A stale PID file or a wrong process both count as dead.

2. If dead: restart detached so it survives this run's session:
   `setsid nohup python3 /home/hatch/workspace/bin/cell-mirror-daemon.py >> /home/hatch/workspace/logs/cell-mirror.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &`
   Wait up to 30s and confirm a fresh PID file exists with a live daemon PID. The daemon refuses to double-start (PID-file guard), so a concurrent start is harmless.

3. REPAIR SWEEP (every run): `python3 /home/hatch/workspace/bin/cell-mirror-daemon.py --repair-only` with a 300s ceiling. This catches in-place content modifications (appends, truncates) that inotify directory watches cannot see — the documented safety net, same role as Dropbox's periodic scan. It also doubles as the catch-up after any daemon downtime.

4. REPORT: one line in the run result — daemon pid + state (running / restarted), repair sweep synced-file count. Stay quiet on success: no fleet post, no user notification. If the daemon fails to start, or the yote bridge (http://127.0.0.1:18301/health) is unreachable, say so plainly in the result — that is the alert.

Do not edit MEMORY.md. Log anomalies to ~/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md only.

Per-lane heartbeat poller (Design B) — Forge lane (forge). Minute cadence, verdict-only: this worker holds no chat tools (proven 2026-10-02), so it never touches chats. It verdicts via the yote poller script and queues shim-shaped nudges for the main agent to drain.

1. Verdict — one exec:
   ~/workspace/bin/yote-conn exec 'python3 /home/toxic/hatch/pollers/lane_poller.py check --lane forge'
   No --chat-silent-min: the script falls back to the agent-dir file-mtime signal. Prints one JSON line; read "status", "silent_min", "consecutive_stalled", "consecutive_unknown", "escalate", "escalate_kind", "queue_nudge".
2. Act on "status":
   - "stalled": queue the nudge for the main agent:
     ~/workspace/bin/yote-conn exec 'python3 /home/toxic/hatch/pollers/lane_poller.py queue-nudge --lane forge --silent-min <silent_min from JSON>'
     (dedupes: one pending request per lane). Final message: "forge stalled (<N>m) -> nudge queued".
   - "escalate": true present: post ONE fleet line, message depends on "escalate_kind":
     - "stalled": SQUAWK_SENDER=Pulse ~/workspace/bin/fleet-post --sender "Pulse" --channel fleet --message "lane Forge unresponsive: <consecutive_stalled> consecutive stalled polls — may need a fresh respawn"
     - "unknown": SQUAWK_SENDER=Pulse ~/workspace/bin/fleet-post --sender "Pulse" --channel fleet --message "lane Forge unobservable: <consecutive_unknown> consecutive polls with no observable activity — may need a fresh respawn"
     then ~/workspace/bin/yote-conn exec 'python3 /home/toxic/hatch/pollers/lane_poller.py escalate-reset --lane forge'.
     Final message: "forge ESCALATED to fleet".
   - "chat_gone" with "already_noted": false: post ONE fleet line:
     SQUAWK_SENDER=Pulse ~/workspace/bin/fleet-post --sender "Pulse" --channel fleet --message "lane poller: the Forge lane chat is archived/completed — poller needs its new chat id".
     Final message: "forge chat_gone -> fleet noted".
   - "unknown": the lane is UNOBSERVABLE — a failure case, never quiet. Queue a nudge for the main agent (no --silent-min; the script uses the unobservable-lane template):
     ~/workspace/bin/yote-conn exec 'python3 /home/toxic/hatch/pollers/lane_poller.py queue-nudge --lane forge'
     (dedupes: one pending request per lane). Final message: "forge unknown (<N> consecutive) -> nudge queued for investigation".
   - "ok" / "stalled_cooldown" / "unknown_cooldown" / "error": quiet. Final message: "forge <status>".
3. Final message is always one line. Delivery goes to the poller-ops chat.
